# FTDI D2XX 1.4.6

This directory contains the FTDI D2XX Linux x86_64 runtime used and
tested with AMBEd.

## Included runtime

Architecture: x86_64
Version: 1.4.6

SHA-256:

5d6f7028f8e5574ae91947a5ce976b35875c2eb37b8deb53640ef82e70d0b834  libftd2xx.so.1.4.6

This exact library has been tested with:

- DVstick-33 / AMBE3003
- USB-3000 / AMBE3000
- Linux Mint 22.3
- AMBEd 1.3.5
- Four simultaneous codec channels

The original FTDI license/information file is included unmodified as
`x86_64/lib/libftd2xx.txt`.

The FTDI D2XX driver is proprietary software from Future Technology
Devices International Limited (FTDI) and is not licensed under the
GPLv3 license covering AMBEd.

Refer to the included FTDI license information for the applicable
terms and restrictions.
